subject: mathematics
content: Let a curve $$y=y(x)$$ pass through the point $$(3,3)$$ and the area of the region under this curve, above the $$x$$-axis and between the abscissae 3 and $$x(>3)$$ be $$\left(\frac{y}{x}\right)^{3}$$. If this curve also passes through the point $$(\alpha, 6 \sqrt{10})$$ in the first quadrant, then $$\alpha$$ is equal to ___________.
